admin.sessionPriceTiersHint: Define one or more price options, e.g. "Adult" = 500, "Child" = 300 — each priced per unit, with its own quantity limit per round. When staff are assigned to a round, each employee gets their own independent stock of that limit (e.g. limit 10 with 2 staff = 20 total). This label has no per-language field, so it shows as-is to every customer regardless of their selected language — write it as "ไทย | English | 中文" (e.g. "ผู้ใหญ่ | Adult | 成人") so it reads correctly for everyone.

admin.settingsSub: Manage business info, booking policy, and payments for your resort.
admin.businessInfoSub: Name, address, and hours shown to customers.
admin.bookingPolicySub: Configure auto-confirmation, and whether customers can cancel or reschedule their own bookings.
admin.autoConfirmDesc: When on, new bookings are immediately "Confirmed" instead of waiting for admin review.
admin.paymentSettingsSub: Configure whether customers can pay a deposit instead of the full amount online.
admin.allowDepositDesc: When on, customers choose "Pay in full" or "Pay deposit" at checkout instead of always paying the full amount.
admin.depositPercentExample: e.g. on a ฿{total} booking, the deposit option collects ฿{deposit} now — the rest is settled later.
admin.depositPercentRange: Deposit percentage must be between 1 and 99.
admin.allowSelfCancelDesc: When on, customers can cancel their own booking from the "Manage Booking" page without contacting an admin (still subject to the notice window below).
admin.allowSelfRescheduleDesc: When on, customers can change their booking's date/time themselves from the "Manage Booking" page — availability is checked automatically.
admin.requireApprovalCancelDesc: When on, a customer's cancellation request doesn't take effect right away — the booking keeps its current status until an admin approves or rejects it on the "Booking Requests" page.
admin.requireApprovalRescheduleDesc: When on, a customer's reschedule request doesn't take effect right away — the booking keeps its current schedule until an admin approves or rejects it on the "Booking Requests" page.
admin.notificationPolicySub: Choose who gets emailed for which booking events.
admin.notifyCustomerGroupLabel: Notify the customer when status changes to
admin.notifyCustomerGroupHint: The initial booking-received email always sends, regardless of this setting.
admin.notifyEmployeeAssignedDesc: Email a staff member when they're assigned to a new booking, or when a customer's reschedule changes who's assigned.
admin.notifyAdminNewBookingDesc: Email every active admin whenever a new booking comes in.
admin.notifyAdminRescheduleDesc: Email admins when a customer submits a reschedule request awaiting approval.
admin.notifyAdminCancelDesc: Email admins when a customer submits a cancellation request awaiting approval.
admin.bookingRequestsSub: Customer cancel/reschedule requests waiting on admin approval.
admin.approveRequestHint: Availability will be re-checked before it's applied, and the customer is emailed the outcome immediately.
admin.rejectRequestHint: The booking stays exactly as it is, and the customer is emailed the outcome along with your note (if any).
